title: GGT-to-alkaline-phosphatase ratio does not establish added temporal HbA1c prediction beyond glucose and separate liver enzymes
abstract: In 2,053 eligible NHANES 2011–2012 adults, adding GGT/alkaline phosphatase to a model trained in 2,378 NHANES 2009–2010 adults changed fasting-weighted HbA1c RMSE from 0.357051 to 0.357064 percentage points: improvement -0.000012, paired source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.003466, 0.000867]. Incremental predictive benefit was not established.
